newsitem.title: USA: U.S stocks seen mixed to slighlty lower at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S stocks seen mixed to slighlty lower at opening.

text.p: U.S. stocks are seen opening mixed to slightly lower on wednesday as Wall Street begins worrying about the next possible change in interest rates, in the wake of the Federal Reserve's decision to leave them unchanged.
Tech stocks should lend the market some strength.
"It should be a slightly lower opening, something of a continuation of yesterday's sell-off, but I'm looking for a reversal later," said Westfalia Investments director of research Peter Cardillo.
